card.name: Zeros inside numbers with commas
card.fires_on: The digit 0 inside a comma-grouped number such as 10,000 or 1,500, usually in dose, count or rate figures. It fires on a zero that comes after the comma or after other digits.

modes.label: Zeros in doses and units
modes.description: A zero within a comma-grouped dose or unit amount.

modes.label: Zeros in counts and rates
modes.description: A zero in cell counts or per-10,000 risk rates.

card.writes: It promotes odd non-digit pieces and suppresses the digits 1 to 8, so it steers the model away from writing another digit next.
card.plain: It marks a zero in the middle of a large number with a comma, like 10,000 or 1,500.
